blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Dexterous manipulation depends on contact dynamics that are often only partially observable from vision.
Recent World-Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive video world modeling with action generation, but remain largely vision-centric and therefore cannot directly model these contact dynamics.
We present Dex Tac WAM , a visuo-tactile WAM that encodes each fingertip independently, aggregates the resulting features through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor, and injects the tactile latent into a video diffusion world model for joint visuo-tactile world modeling.
Across six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on a 22-DoF bimanual platform, DexTacWAM achieves the highest score on every task, averaging 70.6 70.6 versus 38.0 38.0 for the strongest baseline.
Ablations attribute the gain to modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than tactile conditioning alone: removing tactile world modeling reduces the four-task mean from 74.7 74.7 to 26.6 26.6 while keeping the same tactile features and action expert.
After four hours of tactile-encoder adaptation with a frozen pretrained vision VAE, our continual vision-to-touch learning extends the pretrained video model to touch using roughly 100 demonstrations per task without tactile midtraining , while retaining visual prediction quality within 0.5 0.5 dB of vision-only counterparts.
The compressor retains 89.4 % 89.4\% of pre-fusion contact recall while enabling 2.26 × 2.26\times faster training and 1.29 × 1.29\times faster inference.
Together, these results show that pretrained video priors can be extended to distributed multi-finger contact dynamics in a data- and compute-efficient manner.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World models and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, enabling agents to predict action-conditioned futures and generate actions through learned latent dynamics [ 8 , 9 , 4 , 29 ] . Recent robot foundation models and vision-language-action (VLA) policies further demonstrate the potential of large-scale visual representations for general robot control [ 3 , 35 , 20 , 16 , 2 ] . However, most of these models remain largely vision-centric, modeling how the visible scene evolves, but not how hidden physical interaction states evolve. This is a critical limitation for contact-rich manipulation, where task success depends on physical variables such as contact, slip, and grasp stability that are only partially observable from cameras [ 27 , 13 ] . For dexterous hands, the challenge is compounded by the need to coordinate contacts across multiple fingers as hand configuration and hand-object contact geometry change [ 30 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 世界模型和世界行动模型已成为机器人学习的一个有希望的范例,使代理人能够通过学到的潜在动力预测行动条件的未来并产生行动[8、9、4、29]。 最近的机器人基础模型和视觉语言动作(VLA)政策进一步证明了大规模视觉表现对一般机器人控制的潜力[3,35,20,16,2]. 然而,这些模型大多仍然基本以视觉为中心,模拟可见场景是如何演化的,而不是隐藏的物理相互作用状态是如何演化的. 这是大量接触操纵的关键限制,因为任务的成功取决于接触、滑动和抓住稳定等物理变量,而这些变量只能从相机中部分观察到[27、13]。 对于狡猾的手,由于手的配置和手物体接触几何变化[30,15],需要协调多个手指之间的接触,使得挑战变得更加复杂.

blocks.en: Recent works have begun to explore visuo-tactile world modeling by incorporating tactile signals into predictive robot models [ 32 , 12 , 14 , 1 , 5 , 18 ] . These works demonstrate that tactile information can improve world modeling for contact-rich manipulation and validate the importance of predicting both visual and tactile observations. However, existing visuo-tactile world modeling efforts are primarily studied with parallel grippers or relatively simple end-effector setups [ 32 , 12 , 34 , 13 , 28 ] , where tactile sensing is localized and structurally much simpler than the distributed multi-finger tactile observations of dexterous hands. As a result, it remains unclear how to extend visuo-tactile world modeling to dexterous manipulation, where tactile signals must preserve finger identity, contact locality, temporal structure, and hand-pose-dependent contact dynamics.
blocks.zh: 近期的作品已经开始通过将触觉信号纳入预测机器人模型[32, 12, 14, 1, 5, 18]来探索相对激活世界模型. 这些作品表明触觉信息可以改进世界模型,用于丰富的接触操纵,并验证预测视觉和触觉观测的重要性. 然而,现有的相对活性世界建模工作主要是用平行的抓取器或相对简单的终端效应装置[32,12,34,13,28]来研究,这里的触觉感知是局部化的,在结构上比分布式多指触觉观察的脱节手简单得多. 因此,目前仍不清楚如何将相对活性世界的模型扩展至具有欺骗性的操纵,在这种操纵中,触觉信号必须保持手指的特征、接触地点、时间结构以及手柄依赖的接触动态。

blocks.en: A further challenge is the asymmetry between visual and tactile data: human video is abundant, whereas tactile data remain scarce and expensive to collect. Unlike passive visual recording, tactile acquisition requires physical interaction, sensor contact, and often heterogeneous hardware [ 11 , 6 , 7 , 25 ] . These constraints make large-scale tactile pretraining costly and motivate the reuse of representations and predictive priors learned from abundant visual data.
blocks.zh: 另一个挑战是视觉和触觉数据之间的不对称:人类的视频丰富,而触觉数据仍然稀缺,收集费用昂贵。 与被动视觉录制不同,触觉获取需要物理交互,感应接触,并往往有异质硬件[11,6,7,25]. 这些制约因素使得大规模触觉预训成本高昂,并促使人们重新利用从大量视觉数据中吸取的表达和预测前科。

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce Dex Tac WAM , a visuo-tactile WAM for dexterous manipulation. Our key idea is to treat tactile sensing as part of the modeled world state rather than solely using tactile observations as an auxiliary policy input. DexTacWAM extends video-based WAMs to dexterous visuo-tactile co-world modeling, jointly learning visual scene dynamics and multi-finger tactile contact dynamics. To support dexterous hands, DexTacWAM encodes tactile observations from each finger independently and aggregates them through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor to form compact hand-level tactile latents that are injected into a video diffusion world model. The resulting joint visuo-tactile world state is then used by a downstream action expert to generate dexterous actions informed by both visible scene dynamics and evolving tactile contact dynamics.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了Dex Tac WAM,一种用于狡猾操控的Vuo-tactile WAM. 我们的关键思想是将触觉感知作为模拟世界状态的一部分,而不是仅仅将触觉感知观测作为辅助政策投入. DexTacWAM将基于视频的WAM扩展至dexterous visuo-tactile co-world建模,联合学习视觉场景动态和多指触摸接触动态. 为了支持柔软的手,DexTacWAM将每个手指独立的触觉观测编码,并通过手指和姿势知觉的触觉压缩器将其聚合,形成紧凑的手级触觉潜伏,注入视频传播世界模型. 然后,下游行动专家利用由此产生的联合作用世界状态,在可见的场景动态和不断演变的触觉接触动态中,产生具有弹性的行动。

blocks.en: Given this asymmetry, we acquire these tactile predictive capabilities through a continual vision-to-touch learning strategy that extends a model pretrained on visual data to predict tactile contact dynamics while retaining its visual prediction capability. We first adapt lightweight tactile-encoder components using approximately just four hours of recorded interactions, keeping the pretrained visual VAE frozen. We then freeze the tactile encoder and fine-tune the pretrained video backbone for joint visual and tactile prediction using roughly 100 visuo-tactile teleoperation demonstrations per task. The same task demonstrations are used to train the action expert. This approach builds on pretrained visual priors and temporal video dynamics to learn tactile prediction from limited interaction data while preserving visual prediction quality.
blocks.zh: 鉴于这种不对称性,我们通过一个连续的视觉到触摸的学习策略来获得这些触觉预测能力,这一策略将一个预先在视觉数据上训练过的模型延伸至预测触觉接触动态,同时保留其视觉预测能力. 我们首先调整轻量级触觉-编码器组件, 使用大约四个小时的录制相互作用, 保持预先训练的视觉VAE冻结。 然后,我们冻结触觉编码器,并微调经过预先训练的视频主干线,用于联合视觉和触觉预测,每任务使用大约100个相对电动的远程操作演示。 同样的任务演示也被用来培训行动专家. 这种方法基于预先训练的视觉前科和时间视频动态,从有限的交互数据中学习触觉预测,同时保留视觉预测的质量.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows: (1) We introduce Dex Tac WAM , a visuo-tactile world-action model for dexterous manipulation that jointly models visual scene dynamics and distributed multi-finger contact dynamics. (2) We propose a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor that preserves finger identity and localized contact information while mapping five fingertip streams into one latent per hand. This compression reduces computational cost, yielding 2.26 × \times faster training and 1.29 × \times faster inference. (3) We introduce continual vision-to-touch learning , a data- and compute-efficient strategy that extends pretrained visual models with tactile predictive capabilities while maintaining visual prediction quality comparable to vision-only models. (4) We evaluate on six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on real hardware under a protocol that grants every method identical camera access. DexTacWAM achieves the highest score on every task and a mean task score of 70.6 versus 38.0 for the strongest baseline.
Controlled ablations show that the gain comes from modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than from tactile conditioning alone.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 World Models and WAMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 世界模式和WAM

blocks.en:
World models learn predictive representations of environment dynamics, enabling agents to reason about future observations, latent state transitions, and action-conditioned rollouts [ 8 , 9 , 4 , 29 ] . In robotics, recent VLA models and generalist robot policies have demonstrated the potential of large-scale visual representations for action generation across diverse manipulation tasks [ 3 , 35 , 20 , 16 , 2 ] . However, these models are predominantly vision-centric, focusing on how the visible scene evolves or how visual-language features map to actions, without explicitly representing the physical interaction states that govern contact-rich control. Contact, slip, and grasp stability are often hidden or only weakly observable from cameras, but they are central to dexterous manipulation, where contact is distributed across multiple fingers and changes with hand pose and object geometry.
DexTacWAM addresses this gap by extending video-based WAMs to joint visuo-tactile co-world modeling with distributed multi-finger tactile dynamics.
blocks.zh:
世界模型学习环境动态的预测性表述,使物剂能够对未来的观测、潜在的状态过渡和有行动条件的推出进行推理[8、9、4、29]。 在机器人学中,最近的VLA模型和通用机器人政策已经证明了大规模视觉表现对于跨不同操纵任务的动作生成的潜力[3,35,20,16,2]. 然而,这些模型主要以视觉为中心,专注于可见场景是如何演化的,或者视觉语言特征如何映射到动作上,而没有明确代表支配接触丰富的控制状态的物理交互状态. 接触,滑动,和抓住的稳定性往往被隐藏起来,或者从相机上只能弱度地观察到,但它们是离心操控的中心,其中接触分布在多个手指之间,并随着手姿和物体几何变化.
DexTacWAM通过将基于视频的WAM扩展至与分布式多指触控动态的对接式世界模型来弥补这一差距.

blocks.en: 2.2 Visuo-Tactile World Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.2 虚拟世界模拟

blocks.en:
Recent works have begun to incorporate tactile sensing into predictive robot models and world-action frameworks [ 32 , 12 , 34 ] .
VTAM augments a pretrained video-action model with tactile streams for contact-rich manipulation, showing that tactile feedback can correct visual estimation errors and improve action generation [ 32 ] . VT-WM predicts future visual and tactile observations, demonstrating that tactile grounding improves the physical fidelity of imagined rollouts under occlusion and ambiguous contact [ 12 ] . OmniVTA further explores visuo-tactile world modeling with a larger contact-rich manipulation dataset and a world-model-based framework for predicting short-horizon contact evolution [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh:
最近的工作已开始将触觉感知纳入预测机器人模型和世界行动框架[32、12、34]。
VTAM增强预训视频动作模型,带有触觉流,用于接触丰富的操纵,显示触觉反馈可以纠正视觉估计错误,改善动作生成[32]. VT-WM预测未来视觉和触觉观测,表明触觉地面能改善在隐蔽和模糊的接触下想象的展开的物理忠贞性[12]. OmniVTA进一步探索了具有较大接触丰富的操纵数据集和基于世界的预测短视接触演化框架的相对激活世界模型[34].

blocks.en: These works validate the importance of tactile sensing for contact-rich world modeling. However, existing visuo-tactile world modeling efforts are primarily studied with parallel grippers or relatively simple end-effector setups [ 32 , 12 , 34 , 13 , 28 ] , where tactile observations are localized and structurally simpler than those from dexterous hands. In contrast, DexTacWAM targets dexterous manipulation, where tactile signals are distributed across multiple fingers, and the model must preserve finger identity, contact locality, temporal structure, and hand-pose-dependent contact dynamics.
blocks.zh: 这些作品验证了触觉感知对于接触丰富的世界建模的重要性. 然而,现有的相对活性世界建模工作主要是用平行的抓取器或相对简单的终端效应装置[32、12、34、13、28]来研究,这些装置的触觉观测是局部的,在结构上比来自狡猾手的观测简单。 相比之下,DexTacWAM针对的是dexterous的操纵,即触觉信号分布在多个手指之间,模型必须保持手指身份,接触位置,时间结构,以及手触点依赖的接触动态.

blocks.en:
Closest to our setting, ViTacFormer autoregressively forecasts future tactile tokens through an auxiliary head inside its ACT/CVAE policy and feeds the completed forecast back for action generation, without predicting future vision [ 10 ] . Instead, DexTacWAM jointly models future visual and tactile latents as a visuo-tactile world state on which a separate action expert conditions, so touch is predicted jointly with the scene.
Its action expert receives predictive features from a single world-model forward pass, without requiring fully denoised future visual or tactile observations.
This creates a prediction-depth versus latency trade-off absent in forecast-then-act designs.
blocks.zh:
ViTacFormer通过ACT/CVAE政策内的辅助头来自动预测未来的触觉信号, 相反,DexTacWAM联合将未来的视觉和触觉潜质模拟为一个相对活性世界状态,在这个状态上,一个单独的动作专家条件,所以与场景共同预测触觉.
其行动专家从单一的世界模式前传获得预测性特征,而无需完全去声的未来视觉或触觉观测.
这造成了预测深度与暂时性之间的权衡,在当时的预测-行为设计中缺失.

blocks.en: 2.3 Tactile Dexterous Manipulation
blocks.zh: 2.3 Tactile Dexterous 操纵

blocks.en:
Tactile sensing provides direct information about local interaction forces, contact geometry, slip, and grasp stability, making it a critical modality for contact-rich manipulation [ 27 , 11 , 6 , 25 ] . Prior tactile robot learning methods often use tactile observations as policy inputs, auxiliary perception features, or feedback signals for control [ 13 , 31 , 7 , 19 ] . While effective for many manipulation settings, this treatment does not explicitly make tactile contact dynamics part of the modeled world state. For dexterous hands, this distinction is important: tactile observations are distributed across fingers, evolve, and are tightly coupled with hand pose, object motion, and contact geometry [ 15 , 26 ] .
Compressing these streams without accounting for their structure can discard localized contact information, while directly mixing visual and tactile tokens with mismatched distributions can make joint action-model optimization poorly conditioned [ 22 ] . DexTacWAM therefore introduces a structured multi-finger tactile pathway that encodes each finger independently, aggregates tactile information through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor, and injects the resulting tactile latent into the world model for visuo-tactile co-world modeling.
blocks.zh:
Tactile感知能提供当地相互作用力的直接信息,接触几何,滑动,和把握稳定性,使其成为接触丰富的操纵的关键方式[27, 11, 6, 25]. 先前的触觉机器人学习方法往往使用触觉观测作为政策投入,辅助感知特征,或反馈信号用于控制[13,31,7,19]. 这种处理虽然对许多操纵设置有效,但并没有明确地使触觉接触动态成为模拟世界状态的一部分. 对于狡猾的手来说,这种区分是重要的:触觉观测分布在手指之间,进化,并且与手姿,物体运动,和接触几何[15,26]紧密结合.
在不考虑这些流的结构的情况下对这些流进行压缩,可以丢弃局部联系信息,而直接将视觉和触觉信号与不匹配的分布相混合则可以使联合动作模型优化条件较差[22]. 因此,DexTacWAM引入了结构化的多指触觉路径,将每个手指独立编码,通过手指和姿势知觉的触觉压缩器来汇总触觉信息,并将由此产生的触觉潜入世界模型,用于粘着触觉共生世界的模型.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Overall architecture of Dex Tac WAM . A two-block transformer design. Left: the World-Model Transformer ( × N \times N ) fuses vision and bimanual tactile tokens through per-modality self-attention and a shared cross-modality self-attention, producing predictive latents that form a joint visuo-tactile world state. Right: the Action Model ( × N \times N ) cross-attends to the World-Model latents with per-modality K/V RMS normalization, conditioned on a state token from proprioception, and predicts contact force, action, and next-state.

As shown in Figure 1 , the world model learns dynamics over this joint latent state, while the action model conditions on the learned visuo-tactile representation to predict dexterous actions.

blocks.en: 3.1 Multi-Finger Tactile Encoder
blocks.zh: 3.1 多指针 Tactile 编码器

blocks.en: A key design choice in DexTacWAM is to reuse a pretrained visual VAE as the per-finger tactile feature extractor instead of training a tactile VAE from scratch. Dense tactile maps contain spatially organized local structures such as contact regions, deformation patterns, edges, and pressure-sensitive texture changes, making them compatible with image-style latent encoding. Reusing the visual VAE provides a strong spatial prior and maps tactile observations into a latent space compatible with the video diffusion world model. blocks.en: On top of the visuo-tactile world model, DexTacWAM trains an action expert for dexterous action generation. A central challenge is that visual and tactile latents have substantially different token distributions and scales: visual latents are dense and carry global scene information, while tactile latents are sparse and contact-sensitive. Naively concatenating them in a shared cross-attention space results in inconsistent K/V distributions across modalities and makes action-model optimization unstable; in our experiments, the action model fails to converge without modality-wise normalization.

blocks.en: 3.5 Continual Vision-to-Touch Learning
blocks.zh: 3.5 连续愿景对触摸学习

blocks.en:
We train DexTacWAM in three stages that progressively extend pretrained visual representations and video dynamics to tactile prediction and dexterous control.
First, we adapt the trainable components of the tactile encoder, i.e. , the grayscale-to-RGB projection and tactile compressor, while keeping the visual VAE frozen. Pretraining uses a diverse-488 corpus, which contains roughly four hours and 488 episodes of bimanual dexterous manipulation. We train on episodes 0–463 and hold out episodes 464–487 for the tactile representation analyses reported in Section 4.2 .
Second, the video model receives no tactile midtraining: for each downstream task, we freeze the Stage-1 tactile modules and directly finetune the pretrained video model for cross-modal world modeling on approximately 100 task demonstrations using Eq. ( 3 ). Third, we initialize a fresh action expert and train it on the same task demonstrations with the action flow-matching objective in Eq. ( 5 ), without a separate action pretraining stage. This staged procedure uses the diverse interaction corpus to learn a reusable tactile representation, followed by task-specific adaptation of the world model and action expert.

我们训练DexTacWAM分三个阶段,逐步将预先训练的视觉表现和视频动态扩展到触觉预测和离心控制.
首先,我们改造触觉编码器的可训练部件,即灰度对RGB投影和触觉压缩机,同时保持视觉VAE的冻结. Pretrain使用一种多样的488套程序,其中包含约4小时488集的双人性dexterous操控. 我们为第4.2节所报道的触觉表现分析,
其次,视频模型不接受触觉中试:对于每个下游任务,我们冻结Stage-1触觉模块,并直接微调预先训练的视频模型,用于使用Eq.(3 )进行约100项任务演示的跨模式世界模型。 第三,我们启动一名新的行动专家,并培训他从事同样的任务演示,在Eq.(5)中实现行动流量匹配目标,而无需单独进行行动前培训。 这一分阶段程序利用各种互动体学习可重复使用的触觉表现,然后根据具体任务调整世界模式和行动专家。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
Our experiments are designed to answer four questions: (i) does predictive visuo-tactile world-action modeling improve contact-rich dexterous manipulation over strong action policies with direct tactile injection and vision-only world-model baselines; (ii) which components contribute to the performance gain, does the tactile compressor preserve localized multi-finger contact information, and does the world model predict contact evolution rather than simply repeating the latest tactile observation; (iii) can continual vision-to-touch learning acquire tactile predictive capability from task-scale data while retaining visual prediction quality;
and (iv) what training-speed and end-to-end deployment-latency improvements result from tactile compression.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验旨在回答四个问题:(一) 对触觉-触觉-触觉-世界行动模型的预测性改进了对强效行动政策的直触觉注入和唯视-世界模型基线的直触觉操纵;(二) 哪些组成部分有助于性能增益,触觉压缩机是否保存局部多指联络信息,世界模型是否预测接触演化,而不是简单地重复最新的触觉观测;(三) 连续的视向-触觉学习可以从任务尺度数据中获得触觉预测能力,同时保持视觉预测质量;
和(四) 通过触觉压缩,改进培训速度和端到端部署相关性。

blocks.en: Dexterous tactile sensing platform. We use a bimanual dexterous manipulation platform equipped with multi-finger 22-DoF Sharpa tactile sensors that provide dense contact observations over the finger surfaces, allowing the model to observe local contact activation, pressure changes, contact shifts, and contact release during manipulation.
blocks.zh: Dexterous触觉感知平台. 我们使用一个双动的dexterous操纵平台,配备多指22-DoF Sharpa触觉传感器,在手指表面上提供密集的接触观测,使模型能够观察局部接触激活,压力变化,接触转移,以及在操纵时的接触释放.

blocks.en:
Tasks. We evaluate DexTacWAM on six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks that probe complementary aspects of contact-aware control. An illustrative overview of all tasks can be found in Figure Dex Tac WAM : A Visuo-Tactile World-Action Model for Dexterous Manipulation . Cube Place w/ Occlusion tests whether tactile sensing helps when the cube is occluded by the arm itself, whereas Cube Handover requires coordinated bimanual transfer, where grasp stability is hard to infer from cameras alone,
and Two-Hand Wipe requires sustained contact and stable pressure over a long horizon. Tongs requires precise force control for tool-mediated cherry-tomato transfer, Bowl requires thumb–index friction to separate stacked bowls,
and Bottle Cap requires thumb–index friction plus torque for unscrewing, i.e. , rotational contact.
Together these tasks cover occlusion, hand-to-hand transfer, bimanual contact maintenance, tool-mediated force control, friction-dependent separation, and rotational contact.
Per-task grading rubrics are given in Appendix A.1 .

blocks.en: Training data. We first pretrain the tactile encoder’s lightweight projection and compressor on the diverse bimanual corpus while keeping its visual VAE frozen, and then freeze the entire tactile encoder. For each downstream task, we use roughly 100 demonstrations to directly finetune the pretrained video model for cross-modal world modeling and train a randomly initialized action expert. All methods use the same per-task data and their full original training schedules.
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 我们先是将触觉编码器的轻量级投影和压缩器 放在不同的双体上,同时保持视觉VAE的冻结,然后将整个触觉编码器冻结。 对于每个下游任务,我们使用大约100个演示来直接微调预先训练过的视频模型,用于跨模式世界的模型,并训练一名随机初始化的行动专家. 所有方法都使用相同的每个任务数据及其完整的原始培训时间表。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare against two direct policy-learning baselines and one vision-only WAM. π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 23 ] is a generalist robot policy without tactile input, representing large-scale robot policy pretraining.
ViTacFormer [ 10 ] is a strong tactile-vision policy that consumes fingertip force/torque alongside vision; it is an ACT/CVAE policy with an auxiliary tactile-forecasting head.
Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP) [ 28 ] injects the ten fingertip 6-D wrenches directly into a diffusion policy without learning predictive visuo-tactile dynamics.
Genie Envisioner (GE) [ 17 ] is a vision-only WAM, isolating what visual world modeling alone achieves when contact state is only partially visible from cameras.
Implementation details for all baselines are given in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh:
基线。 我们比较了两个直接的政策学习基线和一个只有愿景的WAM。 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5} [23] 是一种没有触觉输入的通用机器人政策,代表大型机器人政策预训.
ViTacFormer [10]是一种强烈的触觉视觉政策,它消耗指尖力/与视觉并列;它是一种ACT/CVAE政策,带有辅助触觉前导头.
反应扩散政策(RDP)[28]将十指6-D扳手直接注入扩散政策,而不学习预测作用力.

Table 1 reports task scores over 20 real-robot trials per method per task.
DexTacWAM obtains the highest score on all six tasks, with an average of 70.6 70.6 versus 38.0 38.0 for the strongest baseline (RDP).
These results are obtained with no tactile midtraining of the video model, an action expert trained from scratch, only four hours of tactile-encoder adaptation using a frozen pretrained vision VAE, roughly 100 demonstrations per task, and no reinforcement-learning post-training, showing that predictive tactile world modeling is effective in a limited-data regime.
The largest margin appears on Tongs ( 60 60 vs. 10 10 ), where the task is completed through a tool, and the only reliable evidence of grasp state is the force transmitted through the tongs; every camera-driven baseline scores at or below 10 10 .
The pattern across tasks is consistent with the hypothesis motivating DexTacWAM: the largest gains appear where task-relevant physical state is difficult to infer from instantaneous visual observations.

表1报告每项任务对20项实际机器人试验的评分。
DexTacWAM在所有六项任务上都获得最高分,最强基线(RDP)的平均分数为70.670.6比38.0 38.0.

最大比值出现在Tongs(60 60 vs. 10 10 )上,通过一个工具完成任务,唯一可靠的把握状态证据是通过tongs传输的力;每个相机驱动的基准得分在10 10或以下.
跨任务模式与推动DexTacWAM的假设是一致的:最大的收益出现在与任务相关的物理状态难以从瞬间视觉观测推断出来的地方。

blocks.en: Comparing the two vision-only entries with the two tactile entries also suggests that tactile conditioning alone is insufficient. RDP receives the same fingertip wrenches that DexTacWAM does, but consumes them as a downstream policy input rather than modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state, and reaches 38.0 38.0 on average. These results suggest that jointly modeling scene and contact dynamics can provide useful predictive features for contact-rich dexterous control.
blocks.zh: 将两个唯视条目与两个触觉条目进行比较也表明,光是触觉调节是不够的. RDP得到与DexTacWAM相同的指尖扳手,但作为下游政策投入消耗,而不是作为预测世界状态的一部分模拟接触进化,平均达到38.0 38.0. 这些结果表明,联合建模场景和接触动力学可以为接触力丰富的弹性控制提供有用的预测特征.

blocks.en: Statistical robustness. To complement the per-task evaluations, we pool outcomes across the four binary tasks (Cube Place, Tongs, Bowl, and Bottle Cap), yielding 80 80 trials per method. DexTacWAM succeeds on 55 / 80 55/80 trials ( 68.8 % 68.8\% ), compared with 24 / 80 24/80 ( 30.0 % 30.0\% ) for the strongest baseline, RDP. The corresponding 95% Wilson confidence intervals are [ 57.9 , 77.8 ] [57.9,77.8] and [ 21.1 , 40.8 ] [21.1,40.8] , respectively, and a Fisher exact test gives p = 1.59 × 10 − 6 p=1.59\times 10^{-6} , indicating that DexTacWAM achieves a statistically significant improvement in overall success rate over RDP.
blocks.zh: 统计稳健性. 为了补充每个任务评价,我们汇集了四个二进制任务(Cube Place、Tongs、Bowl和Bottle Cap)的成果,每个方法共进行了80次试验。 DexTacWAM在55/80号审判(68.8%,68.8\%)上成功,而最强基线RDP是24/80号(30.0%,30.0%,30.0%). 对应的95%的威尔逊置信间隔分别为[57.9,77.8][57.9,77.8]和[21.1,40.8][21.1,40.8],一个费舍尔精确测试给出的p=1.59×10−6p=1.59\times 10^{-6},表明DexTacWAM在统计学上比RDP在整体成功率上取得了显著的提高.

blocks.en: Generalization to unseen object configurations. We evaluate DexTacWAM on Bowl configurations held out from training. Training uses three-bowl stacks in pink, blue, and orange. DexTacWAM succeeds in 13 / 20 13/20 trials on unseen green, purple, and yellow bowls, matching its in-distribution performance, and 12 / 20 12/20 trials on unseen stack heights of two or four bowls. These results demonstrate robustness to changes in appearance and stack geometry. Representative rollouts are shown in Appendix A.3 .

blocks.en: Training and Deployment Efficiency. Compressing ten fingertip streams into two per-hand latents makes tactile world modeling more efficient in both training and deployment. On a single RTX 4090, it reduces the views attended by the DiT from 11 (head + + 10 fingertips) to 3 (head + + 2 hands), cutting view tokens from 3168 3168 to 864 864 ( 3.67 × 3.67\times ) and end-to-end latency from 363.0 363.0 to 281.6 281.6 ms per chunk ( 1.29 × 1.29\times ), below the 1.8 1.8 s action-chunk execution time. Under the same training setup, compression reduces iteration time from 3.87 3.87 to 1.71 1.71 s/iter, a 2.26 × 2.26\times speedup that substantially lowers the cost of scaling visuo-tactile world-model training.

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.2 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate policy-level components using task scores (Table 2 ), while tactile-encoder components are evaluated by contact recall on held-out episodes (Table 3 ). Contact recall provides a more direct measure of how well each encoder variant preserves contact information than downstream task scores. Implementation details for every variant are given in Appendix A.7 .

blocks.en: Effect of tactile world modeling. We remove tactile prediction from the world model and instead condition the action expert directly on encoded tactile features, keeping the tactile encoder, observations, action-expert architecture, action space, and training data fixed. Across the four tasks evaluated in this ablation, the average task score decreases from 74.7 % 74.7\% to 26.6 % 26.6\% (Table 1 ). These results show that the gain depends strongly on modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than on tactile conditioning alone.
blocks.zh: 触觉世界建模的效果. 我们取消了世界模型中的触觉预测, 将动作专家直接附加在编码触觉特征上, 使触觉编码器、观测、动作专家架构、动作空间和培训数据固定下来。 在本次审查评估的四项任务中,平均任务分数从74.7%74.7分下降到26.6%26.6分(表1)。 这些结果表明,收益在很大程度上取决于模拟接触进化作为预测世界状态的一部分,而不是仅依靠触觉调节.

blocks.en: Per-modality K/V RMS normalization. Without per-modality K/V RMS normalization in the action cross-attention, the action expert fails to converge in our experiments: open-loop predictions fail to track ground-truth actions. Differences in visual and tactile feature magnitudes can affect both the attention weights and the scale of the attention output. Per-modality K/V RMS normalization controls these magnitudes when the action expert combines the two modalities, supporting stable training.
blocks.zh: 人均模式K/V 皇家武器正常化。 行动专家未能在实验中趋同:开放的预测无法跟踪地面真实行动。 视觉和触觉特征的大小差异既会影响注意力重量,也会影响注意力输出的规模. 人均模式K/V 当行动专家结合两种方式,支持稳定的训练时,RMS正常化控制了这些规模。

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis of Tactile Representation and World-Model Prediction
blocks.zh: 4.3 泰克西尔特征分析和世界模型预测

blocks.en: We evaluate tactile prediction and whether vision-to-touch adaptation preserves visual prediction quality.
blocks.zh: 我们评价触觉预测以及视线到触觉的适应是否保持视觉预测的质量.

blocks.en: Tactile world-model prediction quality. Table 4 reports prediction quality on held-out trajectories. The predicted tactile futures reach 0.967 0.967 cosine similarity and 0.063 0.063 NMSE against ground truth, with contact precision/recall/F1 of 0.749 / 0.725 / 0.737 0.749/0.725/0.737 in flow space. Because tactile signals are temporally smooth, a forecaster can score well by simply repeating the last observation. We therefore compare against a copy-last-frame baseline and find DexTacWAM attains 0.561 × 0.561\times its error, so the model is predicting contact evolution rather than exploiting smoothness.

5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Dex Tac WAM , a visuo-tactile WAM that extends pretrained video priors to jointly model visual scene dynamics and distributed multi-finger contact dynamics. DexTacWAM achieves the highest task score across all six evaluated tasks, with ablations demonstrating the benefit of explicitly modeling contact evolution beyond direct tactile conditioning. Continual vision-to-touch learning adds tactile predictive capabilities using approximately four hours of recorded interactions for tactile-encoder adaptation and roughly 100 demonstrations per task, while maintaining visual prediction quality comparable to vision-only models. The tactile compressor enables 2.26 × 2.26\times faster training and 1.29 × 1.29\times faster inference, while the action expert uses predictive features from a single world-model forward pass without requiring fully denoised future observations. These results demonstrate a data- and compute-efficient approach to extending pretrained video priors to distributed contact dynamics, providing a practical path toward WAMs for complex physical interaction.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Dex Tac WAM,一种粘着的Tactile WAM,它扩展了预先训练的视频前传,以联合模拟视觉场景动态,并传播多指接触动态. DexTacWAM在所有6项被评价的任务中都实现了最高的任务分数,浮雕显示了明确模拟接触进化,超越直接触觉调节的好处. 连续的视觉对触觉学习增加了触觉预测能力,利用大约4小时的记录相互作用来进行触觉-编码器的适应,每个任务约100个演示,同时保持视觉预测质量可以与仅视觉模型相比. 触觉压缩机可以进行2.26×2.26\时间的快速训练,1.29×1.29\时间的更快推论,而动作专家则使用单一的世界模型前传的预测特征,而不需要完全去声的未来观测. 这些结果显示了一种数据和计算效率高的方法,将事先经过训练的视频前情提要延伸至分布式接触动态,为复杂的物理互动提供了WAM的实用路径.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: While DexTacWAM demonstrates the value of visuo-tactile co-world modeling for dexterous manipulation, it also reveals two limitations. First, our evaluation is restricted to the Sharpa dexterous hand with vision-based tactile sensing, and transfer to other sensing principles, such as capacitive, piezoresistive, piezoelectric, or magnetic sensing, remains untested. Second, both the world model and action expert are trained on successful demonstrations per task. This success-only distribution supports strong nominal execution but provides little supervision for failure recovery or self-correction. Future work should explore broader sensor and embodiment pretraining, as well as failure/recovery data collected through perturbation, intervention, or reinforcement learning; Appendix A.9 provides further discussion.
blocks.zh: 虽然DexTacWAM展示了用Tuuo-tactile共同世界模型来进行狡猾操纵的价值,但它也揭示了两个局限性. 首先,我们的评估仅限于具有视感感感知的夏帕圆形手,转移到其他的感知原理,如电容感知、电感知、电感知或磁感知,仍未经过测试。 第二,世界模式和行动专家都接受了每项任务的成功示范培训。 这种只成功的分配支持有力的名义执行,但对失败的追回或自我纠正几乎没有监督. 今后的工作应探讨更广泛的传感器和化身预训,以及通过扰动、干预或强化学习收集的故障/恢复数据;附录A.9提供了进一步讨论。

The four baselines are chosen to span the design space around DexTacWAM: a generalist VLA policy, a tactile policy with an auxiliary tactile forecasting head, a tactile diffusion policy, and a vision-only WAM.

blocks.en: π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} is a generalist robot policy that represents large-scale robot policy pretraining. It receives no tactile input, and therefore isolates how far a strong pretrained visuomotor prior goes on contact-rich dexterous tasks.
blocks.zh: ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}是代表大规模机器人政策预训的通用机器人政策. 它不接收触觉输入,因此隔离了在接触力很强的灵活任务上事先受过训练的强力粘着电动车有多远。

blocks.en: ViTacFormer is an ACT/CVAE policy that consumes vision together with the ten fingertip 6-D force/torque readings ( [ 18,120 ] [18,120] ) and autoregressively forecasts future tactile tokens through an auxiliary head inside the policy. For deployment on our 22-DoF platform, we retain the released inputs and architecture apart from resizing the action head from 17 to 22 DoF, and align temporal aggregation with the 30 Hz training timeline. The resulting scores are reported in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: ViTacFormer是一种ACT/CVAE政策,它与十指6-D力/调读([18,120] [18,120])一起消耗视觉,并通过政策内部的辅助头来自动预测未来的触觉信号. 为了在我们的22-DoF平台上部署,除了将行动主管从17-22个DOF重新调整规模外,我们还保留了释放的投入和架构,并将时间汇总与30个Hz培训时间表保持一致。 结果得分见表1。

blocks.en: RDP uses head-view visual observations together with the ten fingertip 6-D wrenches as tactile observations, and predicts actions with a diffusion policy. It is the closest baseline to DexTacWAM in terms of raw sensor access: it receives the same tactile signal, but consumes it as a downstream policy input rather than modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state. It is therefore the reference point for the ablation in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: RDP使用头视视觉观测与十指6-D扳手作为触觉观测,并以扩散政策预测动作. 在原始传感器访问方面,它是与DexTacWAM最接近的基线:它接收同样的触觉信号,但作为下游的政策投入消耗,而不是作为预测世界状态的一部分模拟接触进化. 因此,它是第4.2节中废止的参考点。

blocks.en: GE is a vision-based WAM that predicts actions through a video-action modeling framework without tactile input. It tests whether visual world modeling alone suffices when contact state and force are only partially observable from cameras. GE and DexTacWAM share the same backbone scale and action-expert size (Table 7 ), so the comparison between them isolates the tactile pathway rather than model capacity.
blocks.zh: GE是一个基于视觉的WAM,它通过一个没有触觉输入的视频动作模型框架来预测动作. 它检验光是视觉世界模型是否就足够了 当接触状态和力只从相机中部分观察到时. GE和DexTacWAM具有相同的骨干规模和行动专家规模(表7),因此它们之间的比较隔离了触觉路径而不是模型能力.

blocks.en: DexTacWAM consists of a 2B world-model backbone and a 160M action expert. Unlike π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , whose 400M action expert benefits from large-scale action pretraining, our action expert is initialized from scratch and sees only the roughly 100 task-specific episodes. Pretraining the action expert is a clear direction for further gains and remains future work.

blocks.en: For each task in Table 5 , the visuo-tactile world model and its vision-only counterpart use the same training episodes, held-out episodes, camera views, and number of finetuning steps; the only difference is whether tactile views are enabled. Both models are evaluated on future-RGB prediction. Because episode difficulty varies by roughly 2 2 dB, we compute tactile-minus-vision-only differences for matched episodes rather than comparing unpaired means. Each held-out episode is one statistical observation, with its three camera views averaged because views from the same episode are not independent.

blocks.en: Our multi-finger tactile encoder consists of a grayscale-to-RGB projection, a reused visual VAE that maps each per-finger tactile map into a spatial latent grid, and a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor that maps five per-finger latents into one compact per-hand tactile latent. This design reuses the spatial prior of a pretrained video model while preserving multi-finger contact structure.

blocks.zh: A.6 培训细节

blocks.en: We summarize DexTacWAM’s training hyperparameters in Table 8 . The training pipeline has three stages: Stage 1 learns a reusable tactile encoder while keeping its visual VAE frozen, Stage 2 directly finetunes the pretrained video model for cross-modal world modeling on each downstream task, and Stage 3 trains a freshly initialized action expert on the same task demonstrations.

blocks.en: Stage 1 freezes the LTX visual VAE and trains the tactile representation modules with a flow reconstruction objective. Stage 2 freezes the tactile encoder and finetunes the DiT world-model body with the visuo-tactile co-denoising objective. Stage 3 warm-starts from the corresponding Stage-2 world-model checkpoint, initializes a fresh action expert, and trains the action model with the unified 194-dimensional flow-matching action objective.

blocks.en: A.7 Ablation Variant Implementation Details
blocks.zh: A.7 备选案文实施细节

blocks.en: We describe how each variant for ablation results reported in Section 4.2 is constructed.
blocks.zh: 我们描述第4.2节中所报告的每个消化结果的变体是如何构建的。

blocks.en: This variant keeps the tactile encoder, tactile observations, action expert, action space, and training data of DexTacWAM, and removes only tactile prediction from the world model. The action expert is conditioned on encoded tactile features directly instead of on predicted tactile latents. It therefore measures the contribution of predictive tactile world modeling while holding tactile information content fixed.
blocks.zh: 这个变体保留了DexTacWAM的触觉编码器,触觉观测器,动作专家,动作空间以及训练数据,并且只从世界模型中删除触觉预测. 动作专家以编码的触觉特征为条件,而不是以预测的触觉潜伏特征为条件。 因此,它衡量预测触觉世界模型的作用,同时固定触觉信息内容。

blocks.en: This variant removes the parameter-free RMS normalization applied to the multi-view visual and tactile keys/values before the action cross-attention. Everything else is unchanged. The action expert fails to converge: open-loop action predictions do not track ground truth, so we do not proceed to closed-loop evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这个变体取消了在动作交叉注意前适用于多视图视觉和触觉键/值的无参数 RMS 正常化. 其他一切都没有变化。 动作专家未能趋同:开放-启动动作预测无法跟踪地面真相,所以我们不会进行封闭-启动评价.

blocks.en: All variants above are defined by subtraction from the same reference: the full DexTacWAM model, which uses a visuo-tactile world model and conditions the action model on predictive tactile latents. Two properties of that reference are worth stating explicitly, since they are easily conflated. At deployment, the action model takes no force input. Force enters only during training, as the per-finger force block of the unified action target described in Section 3 . Tactile sensing is therefore separated from force-conditioned control: the policy acts on predictive tactile representations, while the auxiliary force supervision keeps the action model from ignoring touch.
blocks.zh: 上述所有变体都是通过从同一参考物中减去来定义的:完整的DexTacWAM模型,该模型使用粘着电动世界模型,并将动作模型作为预测触觉潜伏物的条件. 这一提法的两个属性值得明确说明,因为它们很容易被混淆。 在部署时,行动模式不采用武力投入。 部队仅在训练期间进入,作为第3节所述统一行动目标的每指力块。 因此,Tactile感知与强制条件控制是分开的:在预测触觉表现上的政策行为,而辅助力监督则使动作模型不被忽略触觉.

blocks.en: A.8 Failure Case Analysis
blocks.zh: A.8 失败案例分析

blocks.en: We further analyze representative failure modes observed during real-world evaluation, broken down by task.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析了按任务分列的现实世界评价中观察到的代表性失败模式。

blocks.en: In this task, the wrist cameras are disabled and the robot arm often occludes the cube from the head camera, making precise visual localization difficult. As a result, policies without tactile feedback frequently fail to localize the cube accurately after the hand approaches the object. In particular, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} often fails at the grasping stage because visual observations alone provide insufficient information once the cube is partially or fully occluded by the arm. In contrast, DexTacWAM can use fingertip tactile observations to detect and correct contact with the cube, which improves robustness during the final stage of grasp acquisition. This failure mode highlights the value of tactile feedback when visual information is degraded by self-occlusion.
blocks.zh: 在这个任务中,手腕相机被禁用,机器人手臂经常从头部相机上吞噬立方体,使得精确的视觉定位变得困难. 因此,没有触觉反馈的政策往往无法在手靠近对象后准确定位立方体. 特别是, 0. 5\pi\ 0. 5} 往往在抓取阶段失败, 因为一旦立方体被手臂部分或完全占据, 光是视觉观察就无法提供足够信息 。 相比之下,DexTacWAM可以使用指尖触觉观测来检测和纠正与立方体的接触,这提高了在获取的最后阶段的稳健性. 这种失败模式凸显了视觉信息因自我隔离而退化时触觉反馈的价值.

blocks.en: Cube Handover serves as a standard dexterous manipulation task and provides a contrast to the more contact-rich tasks in our evaluation. The dominant failure mode is sensitivity to the cube’s initial pose. When the initial pose falls outside the training distribution, the left hand may grasp the cube at an inaccurate location or orientation, and this error propagates to the subsequent handover. A promising direction is tactile-informed reinforcement learning for closed-loop correction: once contact is established, fingertip observations provide more direct and detailed information than wrist-camera images about the cube’s pose relative to the fingers and the stability of the grasp, enabling the policy to adjust the grasp before transfer. Even with an action expert trained from scratch, only four hours of tactile-representation pretraining, and no reinforcement-learning post-training, DexTacWAM achieves the highest score among all evaluated baselines on this task, highlighting the benefit of predictive tactile world modeling.
blocks.zh: Cube Handover是标准非曲直操纵任务,与我们评价中接触较多的任务形成对比。 主要故障模式是对立方体初始姿势的敏感性. 当初始姿势在训练分配之外时,左手可能在不准确的位置或方向上抓住立方体,这个错误传播到随后的交接. 一个很有希望的方向是用触觉知情的强化学习来进行闭路校正:一旦联系确定,指尖观测就比手腕相机图像更直接和详细的信息,显示立方体相对于手指的姿势和抓取的稳定性,使得政策能够在转移前调整抓取. 即使一名行动专家从零开始接受训练,但只有四个小时的触觉表现预训,而且没有强化训练后学习,DexTacWAM在这项工作的所有评估基线中都取得了最高的分数,突出了预测触觉世界建模的好处。

blocks.en: The two-hand wipe task requires both stable physical interaction and high-level task completion. DexTacWAM benefits from tactile feedback when maintaining contact with the whiteboard and manipulating the eraser, but its failures are often associated with incomplete task execution. In particular, DexTacWAM may wipe part of the black markings but fail to fully clean the board, suggesting limitations in instruction following and long-horizon task progress monitoring compared with large-scale pretrained VLA models. In contrast, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} often fails because it does not maintain a stable hold on the whiteboard with the left hand. Without tactile feedback, the policy may not detect that the board is slipping or that the left hand is applying insufficient stabilizing force. These failures typically cause the whiteboard to move away during wiping, preventing successful task completion. Thus, this task exposes complementary limitations: DexTacWAM is more robust to contact instability, while π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} benefits from broader pretrained visuomotor priors but struggles with sustained tactile contact.
blocks.zh: 双手擦拭任务既需要稳定的物理互动,也需要完成高级任务. DexTacWAM在保持与白板的接触和操纵擦拭器时从触觉反馈中获益,但其失败往往与不完全的任务执行有关. 特别是,DexTacWAM可能擦除部分黑色标记,但未能完全清洗板,这表明与大规模预先训练的VLA模型相比,在跟踪和长视距任务进度监测的指令方面存在局限性。 相比之下, ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5} 经常失败,因为它不能用左手在白板上保持稳定的支撑. 没有触觉反馈,政策可能无法发现董事会正在滑坡,或左手未充分运用稳定力量。 这些故障通常导致白板在擦拭过程中移走,使任务无法成功完成. 因此,这一任务暴露了互补的局限性:DexTacWAM更能抵御不稳定,而 0.5\pi_{0.5}则从更广泛的预先训练的机动车前科中获益,但与持续的触觉接触相搏。

blocks.en: This task requires precise control of force transmitted through a tool: the robot must hold and close the tongs firmly enough to lift the cherry tomato without allowing it to slip or crushing it. The baselines commonly fail to grasp the tongs stably or to apply an appropriate closing force around the tomato. In contrast, DexTacWAM consistently closes the tongs around the tomato, transfers it to the plate, releases it, and returns the tongs to the table. This behavior highlights the benefit of predicting contact dynamics when the relevant grasp state is mediated by a tool and is difficult to infer visually.
blocks.zh: 这项任务需要精确地控制通过工具传送的力:机器人必须牢牢地握住和关上ng,以抬起樱桃番茄,而不能让它滑动或压碎. 基线通常不能牢牢抓住番茄,或者在番茄周围施加适当的关闭力。 与之相对的是,DexTacWAM始终关闭番茄周围的ng,将其转移到板块上,释放出来,并将ng还给桌子. 这种行为凸显了当相关抓取状态通过工具进行调解且难以在视觉上推断时,预测接触动态的好处.

blocks.en: DexTacWAM coordinates the right thumb, index finger, and middle finger to establish stable opposing contacts and separate the top bowl from the stack. Baseline failures arise when this multi-finger contact is unstable or when spatial inaccuracies cause the fingers to miss or poorly align with the bowl rim. The task therefore requires both accurate spatial alignment and sufficient finger-specific friction to lift one bowl without disturbing the remaining stack.
blocks.zh: DexTacWAM协调右拇指,食指,中指,以建立稳定的对立接触,并将顶碗与堆叠分开. 当这种多指接触不稳定或空间不准确导致手指错失或与碗圈不太吻合时,就会产生基线故障。 因此,这项任务既需要准确的空间对接,也需要足够的指面摩擦,以抬起一个碗而不扰动剩下的堆.

blocks.en: Unscrewing requires the left hand to stabilize the bottle while the right hand, particularly the thumb, maintains friction with the cap and applies torque in a consistent direction. Baselines often grasp the bottle too weakly with the left hand, causing it to tilt, or apply unstable right-hand force directions that dislodge or drop the bottle. DexTacWAM more consistently holds the bottle upright with the left hand while using the right thumb and fingers to rotate and remove the cap, demonstrating coordinated control of stabilizing force, friction, and rotational contact.
blocks.zh: 解脱需要左手稳定瓶子,而右手,特别是拇指则保持与帽的摩擦,并始终向上应用扭矩. 基线常常用左手抓住瓶子太弱,导致其倾斜,或应用不稳定的右手力方向,使瓶子脱落或掉落. DexTacWAM在使用右拇指和手指旋转和去除瓶盖的同时,更一致地用左手把瓶子向右向上握住,展示对稳定力,摩擦力,和旋转接触的协调控制.

blocks.en: A.9 Success-Only Training and Recovery
blocks.zh: A.9 只有成功培训和恢复

blocks.en: Predictive tactile modeling substantially improves contact-rich manipulation by enabling the policy to better exploit contact information during nominal execution. Closing the remaining gap toward more reliable behavior likely requires a second capability: self-correction after mistakes. Our success-only training data provide little supervision for such recovery behavior, leaving failure states such as missed grasps, slip, and dropped objects out of distribution for both the world model and the policy.
blocks.zh: 预测性的触觉模型通过使政策在名义执行期间更好地利用联系信息,大大改进了大量接触的操纵。 缩小剩余差距,实现更可靠的行为,可能需要第二种能力:在错误发生后自我纠正。 我们仅成功的训练数据对这样的恢复行为几乎没有监督,使得失败状态,例如错失了把握,滑倒,以及从世界模式和政策的分发中抛出物体.

blocks.en: This limitation is shared by imitation-based manipulation systems more broadly: once execution deviates from the demonstration distribution, compounding errors and the lack of recovery experience can substantially degrade closed-loop behavior [ 24 ] . Our qualitative inspection suggests a similar pattern: visuo-tactile predictions generally remain plausible before the first execution error, while both prediction and action quality deteriorate after the policy enters unseen failure states. Incorporating failure and recovery experience [ 21 ] through perturbation, intervention, or reinforcement learning is a promising direction for addressing this limitation.
blocks.zh: 这种局限性被更广义的仿真操作系统所分享:一旦执行偏离了演示分布,复合错误和缺乏恢复经验可以大大降低闭路行为[24]. 我们的质检也表明一种类似的模式:在第一次执行错误发生之前,相对作用的预测一般仍然是可信的,而预测和行动的质量则在政策进入未见失败状态之后恶化。 通过扰动、干预或强化学习,纳入失败和恢复经验[21],是解决这一局限性的一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: A.11 Why Continual Vision-to-Touch Learning Works
blocks.zh: A.11. 为什么持续愿景到触摸学习工作

blocks.en: To understand how continual vision-to-touch learning acquires useful tactile representations with limited data, we analyze the features produced by the reused visual VAE and the tactile compressor. We examine task discrimination before and after compression, whether within-task structure reflects interaction progress, and the relationship between visual and tactile latent spaces.

blocks.en: We sample temporal tactile clips from held-out episodes of all six tasks using seed 42 42 , obtaining 1,350 1{,}350 right-hand examples across multiple episodes and temporal positions ( 150 150 per bimanual task and 300 300 per single-hand task). For each clip, we extract two representations: pooled 128 128 -D right-thumb features from the learned grayscale-to-RGB projection and frozen visual VAE, and pooled 128 128 -D hand features from the compressor after fusion of all five fingertips. We visualize each representation independently using PCA to 50 50 dimensions followed by t-SNE with perplexity 30 30 and seed 42 42 . These plots illustrate structure within each representation. All quantitative metrics are computed in the original 128 128 -D feature space; 5 5 -nearest-neighbour and linear-probe classification use stratified five-fold evaluation.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 9 , the right-thumb features distinguish the six tasks, achieving 95.6 % 95.6\% 5 5 -nearest-neighbour accuracy and 99.0 % 99.0\% linear-probe accuracy, compared with a 16.7 % 16.7\% uniform chance level and a 22.2 % 22.2\% majority-class baseline. These results show that a frozen pretrained visual VAE, combined with a learned grayscale-to-RGB projection, can provide task-discriminative tactile features without training a tactile VAE from scratch.

blocks.en: The compressed hand representation achieves 96.4 % 96.4\% 5 5 -nearest-neighbour accuracy and 99.6 % 99.6\% linear-probe accuracy, with a silhouette score of 0.081 0.081 , compared with 0.060 0.060 for the right-thumb representation. Thus, the hand latents remain strongly task-discriminative after 5 : 1 5{:}1 compression, making tactile world modeling efficient while preserving the task-relevant structure.

blocks.en: Visual and tactile latents remain well separated, with a between- to within-modality distance ratio of approximately 89 89 . The observed benefits of reusing the visual encoder therefore do not imply that visual and tactile observations map to a shared, modality-invariant representation. A pretrained visual encoder can provide useful tactile features while the two modalities retain distinct feature distributions.
